# Writing a `synthesis` page

Generated from `synthesis`'s own template declarations. It states what this type requires;
the rules that apply to every page are in `wiki-authoring-spec.md` beside this file.

- **Lives at** `domain/synthesis/<kebab-claim>.md`
- **Authorship** `derived` — an agent authors it from named `sources:`
- **Freshness** stale after 180d
- **Template version** 1 — set `template-version: 1`

## Frontmatter

Required on this type beyond the base fields (`title`, `type`, `created`, `updated`, `owner`, `authorship`):

- `sources`

The template also scaffolds `template-version`, `related`, `origination`, `confidence` — fill or empty each one; leaving a placeholder is an error.

`owner:` is fixed to `domain` — do not change it.

## Placeholders to replace

{{TITLE}} {{DATE}} {{ORIGINATION}} {{CONFIDENCE}} {{SOURCE_PATH_1}} {{SOURCE_PATH_2}}. Leaving one in place is an error (`unsubstituted-token`), and so is leaving a template example line (`template-example-line`).

## Where this type may link

This page lives in `domain/` (layer 0).

You may link to other pages in `domain/` and to no other sub-wiki: nothing sits below it.

You may not link to `product/`, `design/`, `engineering/`, `operations/`, `gtm/`, `governance/`. Those sub-wikis cite this one, never the other way round; when you need to name something there, name it in prose instead of linking it.

## Sections

Keep every heading, in this order: `## Claim`, `## Supporting sources`, `## Contradicting sources`, `## Confidence`, `## Implications`.

## What the audit checks on this page

Because of the declarations above: template-sections, section-order. Every page is also checked for empty sections, heading restatement, callout types and code pointers. Run `/wiki-conformance-audit` to see the full list with its verdict.

## After you save

Two steps finish the page and neither is in the template:

- Commit the file under your own identity — authorship is a git fact, not a frontmatter one.
- Run `/wiki-reindex` so the page appears in its sub-wiki `index.md` and in `_derived/cited-by.md`. Until then it exists but nothing links to it.
